title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that the lack of a bound state for two neutrons indicates the spin dependency of the nuclear force.

title: Spin States Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain the difference between singlet and triplet spin states and their relevance to binding.

title: Energy Level Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The response must mention that the energy level of the singlet state is higher than that of the triplet state.

title: Charge Independence Note
description: Optional Criteria: The response could briefly discuss the charge independence of the nuclear force as a context for the problem.

title: Common Misunderstanding
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid incorrectly stating that two neutrons can form a bound state due to charge independence.
